title: OpenAI and Ironclad train agents on complete contracting workflows
friendlyTitle: OpenAI tests agents on full contract jobs
summary: OpenAI and Ironclad created 11 research tasks covering legal, commercial and procurement workflows, each scored against multiple detailed criteria. GPT-6 Astra averaged 55.0% on the tasks versus 41.6% for GPT-5.6 Sol, while estimated attempt time fell from 37.0 to 19.2 minutes; OpenAI says the figures are research results, not measured customer savings.
friendlySummary: OpenAI and Ironclad built 11 realistic tasks for setting up contracts and approvals. The newer model did better and worked faster in the test, but it still missed many requirements.
whyItMatters: Training on end-to-end business rules is more useful than teaching an agent isolated clicks, because one missed approval or clause can invalidate the whole result. The 55% score also leaves ample room for failure, so contract work still needs controlled environments, explicit acceptance checks and human oversight.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Business agents must follow the whole process, not just complete separate steps. People still need to check legal work because the best tested model was far from perfect.
